title: Eval Baseline Library: access controls and change protocol for prompt/benchmark bundles
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Design and implement a guarded lifecycle for our canonical evaluation baselines (prompt bundles and curated dataset slices) to ensure model/config changes cannot introduce silent quality regressions. This ticket covers the policy, access model, change workflow, automation hooks for gating and rollback, and required telemetry/alerts.
acceptance_criteria: A documented policy for who can propose, approve, and publish baseline bundles
An auditable change workflow that ties bundle changes to a PR, owner, and mandatory eval runs
Automated gating: any model/config change that references a baseline triggers a regression check with pass/fail thresholds
Storage and versioning that preserves immutable snapshots of published baselines and allows rolling back to any prior snapshot
RBAC enforced via Console groups and mapped SSO roles; UI and API level ACLs
Alerting to SLT and on-call when regression detection causes automatic rollback or requires manual intervention

implementation_notes: 1) Storage: use content-addressed blob store + signed immutable manifest files; manifests authored via GitOps PRs for traceability.
2) Metadata: extend model-artifact service with read/write audit trail and semantic version field for bundles (semver-like but date+hash preferred).
3) Workflow: publish flow = propose -> run mandatory regression evals -> approvals (Research + Security for P0) -> publish (immutable manifest).
4) Gating: CI hook and runtime deploy hook to block model/config promotion if regression delta > threshold for any mandatory baseline. Thresholds configurable per baseline.
5) Console: add Baseline Library page with publish history, diff view for prompt/label changes, and 'revert to snapshot' action that triggers a canary eval before full revert.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: publishing friction slows research iteration. Mitigation: fast-path draft bundles for internal experiments that are not referenced by production routes.
Risk: eval flakiness causes false rollbacks. Mitigation: require repeated failure across N runs and include stability score in gating logic.
Risk: RBAC complexity for enterprise customers. Mitigation: map Console groups to SSO roles and provide managed default roles with ability to customize per org.
